message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. MFA for administrators blocks authentication to DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. MFA for database administrators then blocks authentication to the database, file server, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if database administrator credentials are stolen. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server secret-leak route available; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed by obtaining admin_dc or admin_adfs. Any other single control leaves the phishing → internal access → application authentication → stolen administrator credentials → DC/ADFS → data exfiltration route available. Segmentation alone is bypassed by escalating an unpatched workstation or laptop."}
